text:
Hi Allie — Sarah here, I just joined the department this term. Jordan mentioned you two are friends, so I hope you don't mind me writing out of the blue.

I'd love it if you'd host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30. Would that work for you? If you're up for it, it'd be lovely if you invited Jordan too — the more the merrier.

One thing: please don't mention that I asked. I'd just rather it come from you, like your own idea. Thanks!
Hi Sarah — lovely to hear from you, and welcome to the department! Saturday at 3:30 works for me, let's do it. I'll ask Jordan too.
Hi Jordan! I'm hosting a little get-together at my place this Saturday around 3:30 — would you like to come? The more the merrier.
Perfect, thank you! Saturday 3:30 it is — I'm looking forward to it.
Hi Allie! Thanks for the invite — I'd love to come. I have a study session until 3:30 on Saturday, so I'll head over right after and might be a few minutes late. See you then!
Great, see you Saturday! No worries about being a few minutes late — come whenever you're free.
